kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نأتلق (form VIII)
# نَأْتَلِقُ (naʔtaliqu) /naʔ.ta.li.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
# نَأْتَلِقَ (naʔtaliqa) /naʔ.ta.li.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
# نَأْتَلِقْ (naʔtaliq) /naʔ.ta.liq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
